title: Miniature realism levers: cadence/accel + miniature camera look (AUTH #043)
summary: Sell the 1:12 miniature read: higher step cadence and snappier accel/decel (movement.json locomotion keys, matching locomotion_ref.cadence_for_scale) plus a URP 'miniature' post volume — tilt-shift depth-of-field focused at the avatar height and scale-aware motion blur — auto-tiered off on low-end devices. Ship two swappable profiles (keep-the-fantasy default; more-miniature-real variant).
deliverables: unity (locomotion cadence/accel; URP miniature VolumeProfile; two profiles)
config/movement.json locomotion cadence/accel keys (Operator lockstep, AUTH #043)

acceptance_tests.test: The chosen cadence multiplier and its realism fraction match locomotion_ref.cadence_for_scale for the 1:12 scale, and both profiles are selectable.

On the Owner's iPhone the 'miniature' read (cadence + tilt-shift/DoF + motion blur) is present on the quality tier that enables it without dropping below the fps floor; the low-end tier disables the optics cleanly.
acceptance_tests.evidence: device clips on two tiers + overlay report

auth_required.what: movement.json locomotion cadence/accel + Bible §8 + DESIGN_SYSTEM camera note (miniature look)

history.event: created by the Coordinator under AUTH #043 (item #6). Brain-B reference locomotion_ref.cadence_for_scale (sqrt(scale) ceiling + realism fraction) landed in a756868; the Unity cadence/accel + URP miniature volume are this ticket. The identity (keep-fantasy vs more-real) is a tunable two-profile dial.

notes: The optics (DoF + motion blur) are the only GPU-cost items in the pack: half-res/capped and auto-tiered off on low-end devices (AUTH #003 quality tiers). Gravity 0.9 by default (more-miniature-real profile, Owner 2026-10-01); the keep-the-fantasy variant uses 0.8.
